expect_red: opening a balloon crop's hover CARD fetches its parts-list companion too — the card's list is built separately and carries the same second image

mutations.contract: The hover card builds its own fetch list and carries the same second image: a balloon crop's card shows the parts-list row, not the missing-image line.
mutations.note: The same companion term, in the second of the three places it is written (`cardPngs`). A separate entry from the pane's because `imageCache` is shared -- whichever fetcher reaches a PNG first is the only one that touches the adapter, so the two can only be observed on two different rows and only fail one check each.
